title: privacy violation: static IPV6 address is logged
body:
IPV6 addresses under "ifconfig" are [not properly scrubbed](https://linux-hardware.org/index.php?probe=fb4890a4dd&log=ifconfig)

/128 addresses are visible!
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Hello,

This is now fixed by the commit 0fd5fc5c1c008285650d1909edabe57bf8608ab3.

Thanks!

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
